headline: You cannot trust you would find out if something went wrong.
subheadline: Ateles is the distributed-authority operating layer for governed initiative.
body: So you are back to babysitting the work — the exact thing delegation was supposed to remove, across every domain you run through agents, personal and professional. Every agent shares your identity, so a merge, a payment, or an outbound message it sent leaves nothing in the record separating what you did from what it did on your behalf. Ateles makes authority explicit instead of implicit — who may act, on whose authority, against which state, through which workflow, with which approvals — so your attention goes to the decisions that actually need you, and everything else runs without you having to watch it.
